Entry.JapaneseText: 『いばらの森』サンドリオン ガルデニア空域から離脱完了
Entry.EnglishText: The Forest of Thorns Cendrillon has successfully withdrawn from Gardenia's orbit!

Entry.JapaneseText: 空間および思念探査——反応なし。 ガルデニアの完全消滅を 確認しました
Entry.EnglishText: No responses regarding any Will from the area. Confirmation that Gardenia has been completely annihilated.

Entry.JapaneseText: う、うう………… クリードの……バカ野郎ッ…………
Entry.EnglishText: *sniff*... Creed... you fool...!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Shing>…… クリードもフローラさんも ああなる事を望んだんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Shing... Creed and Fluora wanted that for themselves.

Entry.JapaneseText: どんなに想いをつなげても 人が人である以上 全てを救う事はできません……
Entry.EnglishText: No matter how much you try to appease to them, humans will always only be human, and you can't save everyone.

Entry.JapaneseText: けれど、貴方の優しさは クリードと姉様のスピリアを あたためてくれましたわ
Entry.EnglishText: Though I believe that your warmth got across to Creed and Fluora. I'm sure of it.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふたりに代わってお礼を 言わせてください。 ……本当にありがとう
Entry.EnglishText: I'd like to express gratitude in their place. Thank you, Shing.

Entry.JapaneseText: そんな……オレこそ リチアにお礼を言わなきゃ…… 世界を救ってくれて……
Entry.EnglishText: No... I should be thanking you if anything... for saving the world...
Thank you...

Entry.JapaneseText: あらあら、こんな子が世界を 救ったなんて、きっと誰も 信じてくれないわねぇ？
Entry.EnglishText: My, nobody's going to believe a crybaby like this saved the world, you know?

Entry.JapaneseText: リチア様、ガルデニアから 解放されたスピルーンの欠片が 結晶界に落下していきます
Entry.EnglishText: Lady Lithia. The Spirune shards that were floating around Gardenia have fallen to Quartzia.

Entry.JapaneseText: リチア、これで結晶人たちは 白化から回復するの？
Entry.EnglishText: Lithia, do you think the Quartz will be able to recover from their calcification?

Entry.JapaneseText: あの小ささでは 人のスピリアとして 機能するかどうか……
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder if such tiny Spirias are capable of such a thing...

Entry.JapaneseText: わたくしは信じます。原界との リンクによって、あの欠片たちが 少しずつ輝きを取り戻し……
Entry.EnglishText: I believe they will. I'd like to think that the link Quartzia has to Celland will result in those shards recovering a little of their light...

Entry.JapaneseText: 何百、何千年後の未来に 『新しい生命』として 生まれ変わる事を——
Entry.EnglishText: I believe that in hundreds or thousands of years from now, life will be reborn in Quartzia...

Entry.JapaneseText: リチア様、だったらアタシが リンクが途切れないように ずっと見張ってるよ
Entry.EnglishText: Lady Lithia, then I will watch over the link to make sure it never severs!

Entry.JapaneseText: 良いのですか、コランダーム？
Entry.EnglishText: Are you sure, Corundam?

Entry.JapaneseText: うん。元々、サンドリオンは ソーマリンクのサーバーとして フローラ様がつくったんだし
Entry.EnglishText: Of course! Lady Fluora made me to control Cendrillon's Soma Link functions anyway.

Entry.JapaneseText: 未完成だったリンク機能が なんで発動したのか観察するのって 超〜〜〜オモシロそうっ♪
Entry.EnglishText: Watching over a link to make sure it never snaps sounds like a b-l-a-s-t!

Entry.JapaneseText: そ〜ゆ〜訳で、原界人ども！ サボらないでスピリアを伝えろよ！ きゃははっ♪
Entry.EnglishText: So all you Cellites better put in the work to make sure your Spirias direct light to us! Teehee!

Entry.JapaneseText: そっか、オレたちが ずっと想いをつなげていけば……
Entry.EnglishText: I see, so if we keep sharing our feelings with one another...

Entry.JapaneseText: いつか 白い月が新しい世界として 生まれ変わるんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Someday, life will be reborn on the Ivory Moon!

Entry.JapaneseText: これでもう想い残す事は ありません……わ……
Entry.EnglishText: Now, I will have no re...grets...
Lithia?!

Entry.JapaneseText: 時間がきたようです…… 最後に、ひとつだけ…… <Kunzite>の事をお願いします
Entry.EnglishText: It looks like my time has come at last. This is my final wish to you all. Please, look after Kunzite for me.

Entry.JapaneseText: 長い間ありがとう、<Kunzite>。 これからはひとりの人間として 自由に生きてください
Entry.EnglishText: Thank you so much for staying with me all this time, Kunzite. I would love for you to live the rest of your life, freely, as a human.
Master... Lithia...

Entry.JapaneseText: やっとリチアが、ゆっくり 暮らせる日が来たのに…… 何か方法はないの!?
Entry.EnglishText: Lithia finally has the chance to relax and live freely! Is there nothing we can do?!

Entry.JapaneseText: いいのです…… わたくしの願いは貴女たちが 全部かなえてくれましたもの
Entry.EnglishText: It's fine. All of my wishes have been fulfilled by you all.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……方法ならあるぜ。 <Kunzite>のスピルメイズを 使えば、多分な……
Entry.EnglishText: ...There's a way. If we use Kunzite's Spirmaze. At least I think...

Entry.JapaneseText: クリノセラフはスピルメイズの 時間を何度も繰り返して 白化の日を再生させていた
Entry.EnglishText: Clinoseraph used his Spirmaze to warp time, reliving the day of the calcification over and over.

Entry.JapaneseText: 擬似スピリアはスピルメイズの 時間を操作できるんだろ？
Entry.EnglishText: So all synthetic Spirias are capable of warping time, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: 時間をとめた<Kunzite>の スピルメイズで眠りにつけば 生き続けられるんじゃないのか？
Entry.EnglishText: If Kunzite pauses time within his Spirmaze and you sleep inside it, wouldn't you be able to live forever?
...It is theoretically possible.

Entry.JapaneseText: それだよ！ <Kunzite>なら半永久的に 死ぬ事はないし、そうしなよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: That's it! Kunzite can distort time! That way, you'll never die! It's genius!

Entry.JapaneseText: いけません！ それでは<Kunzite>まで 永遠の眠りについてしまう……
Entry.EnglishText: I cannot! That would make Kunzite have to sleep for an eternity with me!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……<Kunzite> てめぇはどうしたいんだ？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Kunzite. What do you want?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……しゅ、守護機士が 主に意見するなど 許されるはずが……
Entry.EnglishText: A-As a Mechaknight, I must respect my master's wishes...
So that's your answer.

Entry.JapaneseText: だったら、俺と行こう、リチア！ どんなにわずかな時間でも…… 俺は、お前と一緒にいたい!!
Entry.EnglishText: Then come with me, Lithia! No matter how little time you may have left, I want you to spend it together with me!

Entry.JapaneseText: 心配すんな…… 墓だって俺がたててやる
Entry.EnglishText: Don't you worry. I'll even be the one to bury you when the time comes.
W-Wait!

Entry.JapaneseText: リチア様、お願いです！ どうか………… どうか自分の中で生きてください！
Entry.EnglishText: Lady Lithia, please! I ask that you live on inside me!
Kunzite... But then you'll...

Entry.JapaneseText: この体が朽ち果てるまで アナタのあたたかさを守る…… それが自分のスピリアの願いです
Entry.EnglishText: Until my body crumbles away, I wish to protect the warmth of your very being. That is what my Spiria wishes for!

Entry.JapaneseText: ふん…… やっと素直になりやがったか
Entry.EnglishText: Heh. Now you're speaking your thoughts!

Entry.JapaneseText: 伝わってるよな、リチア？ お前に生きて欲しいっていう 俺たちの願いが
Entry.EnglishText: Hear that, Lithia? We all want you to keep on living.

Entry.JapaneseText: わたくしは……まだ生きていて 良い人間なのでしょうか？
Entry.EnglishText: Am I... really allowed to keep living, as awful as I am?

Entry.JapaneseText: お願いします、リチア。 あなたが守った世界の 行く末を見届けてください
Entry.EnglishText: Please, Lithia. We want you to keep watching over this world you worked so hard to save.

Entry.JapaneseText: オレたち頑張るよ！ リチアの見る 夢……『いばらの森』に届く想いが あたたかいものであるように！
Entry.EnglishText: We'll do our best, in order to make sure our feelings and warmth reach you within your dreams... within the Forest of Thorns!

Entry.JapaneseText: うん！ それが、あなたへの恩返しだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Yes. That's what we can do for you!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ありがとう、<Kunzite>。 ……ありがとう、みんな
Entry.EnglishText: ...Thank you, Kunzite. Thank you, everyone.

Entry.JapaneseText: ぐふふ…… でも、誰かさんたちの想いは 夢に見るには情熱的すぎかもぉ？
Entry.EnglishText: Heeheehee. Though won't some of your feelings be a little too spicy for her dreams?

Entry.JapaneseText: ええ、二千才のおばあちゃんには 刺激が強すぎますわ
Entry.EnglishText: This is true. It might overwhelm a two-thousand year old lady such as myself.
...It seems it's time to say goodbye.

Entry.JapaneseText: 原界に戻ったら ボク、リチアの絵本を 描いてもいいかな？
Entry.EnglishText: When we get back home, do you mind if I draw your portrait?

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界中の子どもたちが リチアに想いをはせるような ドキドキワクワクの冒険物語だよ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'd love to paint the journey you had, and show all the kids in the world your feelings!
That sounds wonderful!

Entry.JapaneseText: 自分も勇ましく 描かれる事を希望する
Entry.EnglishText: I would like to be drawn gallantly in your story.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふ〜んだ、芸術家に注文つける なんて……おこがましいよっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph! You're a silly goose for expecting an artist to draw you how YOU want!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Ines>……貴女からは 人の『強さ』を教わりました。 今までありがとう
Entry.EnglishText: Ines. I learned so much about the strength of humans from you. Thank you so much.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私こそ、あなたの強さを 見習わせてもらうわ
Entry.EnglishText: Your strength inspires me too, you know.

Entry.JapaneseText: 強くなきゃ、女は やってけないものね♪
Entry.EnglishText: Women have to be strong!

Entry.JapaneseText: 何を言っている？ リチア様に<Ines>ほどの 戦闘力はないが……？
Entry.EnglishText: What are you saying? Lady Lithia's strength has nothing on yours.

Entry.JapaneseText: わたし……言いたい事 いっぱいあるのに…… 何を話したらいいか……
Entry.EnglishText: I have so much I want to say... where do I even start...?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……全部わかっていますわ。 貴女が生まれる前から 一緒だったんですもの
Entry.EnglishText: ...I think I already know. I've been with you before birth, after all.
Hisui...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……わ、悪かったな。 色々つらくあたっちまって……
Entry.EnglishText: ...S-sorry. For always being so harsh on you...

Entry.JapaneseText: 貴方の優しさと、この胸の熱さ…… ずっと忘れませんわ
Entry.EnglishText: I will never forget you, or the kindness and passion you hold in your heart.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふ、ふん……俺も忘れねぇよ。 てめぇの頑固さと…… あたたかさを……な
Entry.EnglishText: Heh! I won't forget you either! Especially your stubborness... and your warmth...

Entry.JapaneseText: リチアを頼むぜ、<Kunzite>！ 俺がわざわざ 言うまでもねぇだろうがな……
Entry.EnglishText: Take care of Lithia for me, Kunzite! I know I don't need to ask you that, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: 否……<Hisui> オマエと約束させてくれ。 リチア様を永遠に守る——と
Entry.EnglishText: Negative. Hisui, you kept your promise, to lead Lady Lithia to protect the endless future.
Shing, it's time we said goodbye.

Entry.JapaneseText: 自分も可能ならば、オマエ同様 抑制も理性的判断も無分別に 放棄し、涙を放出したい状況だ
Entry.EnglishText: If it was programmed within me, I would also like to cast aside the rational thoughts that exist within me, and shed tears alongside you.

Entry.JapaneseText: な、なんだよ!? 難しく悪口言ってるだけだろ <Kunzite>？
Entry.EnglishText: H-Hey! Are you just making fun of me?

Entry.JapaneseText: ふふふ、<Shing>は やっぱり<Shing>ですわね
Entry.EnglishText: Hehe. Shing will always be Shing.

Entry.JapaneseText: さよならは言わないよ。 オレたちの想いは、ずっと……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I won't say goodbye. After all...

Entry.JapaneseText: つながってるんだからさ！
Entry.EnglishText: Our feelings will always be linked with yours!

Entry.JapaneseText: はい。 では『おやすみ』ですわね
Entry.EnglishText: Yes. In that case, let me say good night.

Entry.JapaneseText: おやすみなさい。 元気で、泣き虫で…… そして優しい勇者様
Entry.EnglishText: Good night. My cheerful, crybaby... kind hero.

Entry.JapaneseText: おやすみなさい。 想いをつなげてくれた仲間たち。 大切な、わたくしの家族たち
Entry.EnglishText: Good night, all my friends who have blessed me with the feelings they hold deep in their hearts. Good night, my beloved family.

Entry.JapaneseText: おやすみ……<Kunzite>。 おやすみ……リチア
Entry.EnglishText: Good night, Kunzite. Good night, Lithia.

Entry.JapaneseText: おやすみ……<Kunzite>。 おやすみ……リチア
Entry.EnglishText: Good night, Kunzite. Good night, Lithia.

Entry.JapaneseText: くはははっ！ リチアよ、結晶界最高位の 思念術士であったお前が
Entry.EnglishText: Gahaha! To think you were one of Quartzia's greatest Will mages...

Entry.JapaneseText: 今は、そんな風船に 頼らねば空も飛べんとは…… こっけいを通り越して哀れだな
Entry.EnglishText: Yet now you cannot even traverse the skies without the aid of a primitive balloon... it's beyond pathetic.

Entry.JapaneseText: きゃはは♪ こっけい、こっけい！ 哀れで笑える〜〜〜
Entry.EnglishText: Nyahaha! ♪ Patheeetic, patheeetic~!

Entry.JapaneseText: しかも、こびへつらって 原界人の助けを借りおって ……見苦しい！
Entry.EnglishText: And what's worse is enlisting the aid of those filthy Ceillites... you disgust me!

Entry.JapaneseText: お前など、醜いスピリアに あふれた地上を這いずり回って いるのが似合いだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Writhing around in the dirt amongst their unsightly Spirias suits you!
